doc.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

title: Critics, record-date experts and wine analogies
summary: He says Giddins and Japanese discographers know facts but not the music, with Jon Faddis as a wine-lore example.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: A stream of consciousness. If something comes to mind I just say it. As long as Gary Giddins doesn’t hear it it’ll be fine.
He just put out a pretty big book I think recently.

He’s a smart guy man, he’s very smart. He knows a lot and doesn’t understand anything. I mean that’s just my opinion. You know there are people that don’t know anything about music or history, and they sit and listen and they can tell you what they felt and what they thought you were trying to do, and they can nail it.

I mean I meet little girls and stuff, like or old people. And they come and they start talking about this real shit, real stuff that’s important. And it’s encouraging. But there are people who can really understand music, I mean the essence of music, not who played what what year and who was influenced by who and all this bullshit.
Yeah. That’s kind of all just the historical logistics of it.
I met guys in Japan that know everything. Know every record date, who was on it and what time it was, and don’t understand a damn thing about this music.
Or there are people that know everything about wine and don’t have the faintest idea of what the real taste is.
Yeah. They just know the vintages and the companies.

Jon Faddis knows like, he knows everything. He doesn’t drink. He doesn’t drink at all but he has, I think it’s his chiropractor or somebody, who is a wine guy, and he’s always talking to him about it. And Jon’s got like a photographic memory. So he remembers all this information and he comes over to me and he starts mentioning this and this and this, and he never tasted anything in his life. He could be a wine writer.
